[itsmoe] I know right. These should be selling at $400 max all year round. Everyone is jumping on this inflation bullshit wagon and increasing their prices for no reason.

[3dprintdeals] if you are waiting for Christmas, I would wait for the Black Friday sale in a month time.
You won't have any issue with stock for the A1.

[3dprintdeals] good deal if you combined with gc.
Don't wait until Christmas to open it, so by the time school holidays is here they have 6 weeks of printing fun.
I just got mine to print out this T-Rex 3D Puzzle and put it together today. Kept him occupied for a while. He know's how to operate the A1 mini.
[4mOzfan] I recently bought kitchenaid KF3 and I think with the quality of coffee dispensed by it along with the look and feel with Digital Touch and one touch coffee dispense options, these Breville and SMEG options are not worth going for. Instead, it is worth spending few 100 dollars more on KF2/KF3 kitchenaid models.
[Nom] Erm, it's $1350… https://kitchenaid.com.au/products/kes8453-fully-auto-espres…
[jackary] I mean it looks nice, and I believe they are manufactured by the same company that makes the Miele coffee machine range, but that is hardly a statement of praise considering their appalling reliability. Also why are you comparing a manual espresso machine to a fully automatic one? I love my Jura but I know damn well the bambino would make a better coffee, if I put the time and effort in.
[Yve] KF3 is referred to as a Bean-To-Cup Machine or Fully Automatic.
They're not really comparable to a manual machine like the Breville
The Breville is a lot more difficult to use but can yield a better cup of espresso if you learn to use it.
It also has the scalability of buying a better grinder to tackle more diverse bean options and accessories to help with consistency (Portafilter upgrades, Basket upgrades, Puck screens, etc).
A Bean-To-Cup Machine is something you'd just dial in once for a Darker roast from a specific cafe or supermarket blend you'd just stick with for the life of the machine.
[justanick] Hey All, I am tossing up between the Breville Bambino Plus and the Breville Barista Express. I got encore esp grinder.
If it’s Bambino plus what’s the price now and Black Friday forecast / previous years?
FYI I have had sunbeam barista for 6 years but it’s dying out. The pressure is not building up for the coffee shots. Tried everything.
[jackary] If you have an external grinder, why would you want the barista express? The bambino would be totally cromulent.
[justanick] Okay .. makes sense. What price point can I can I got a bargain? Few months back there was a huge Amazon sale but can’t remember the price.
